protocol: Five sequential live repeats; saved base reset excluded; total includes hit testing, edit, full uncapped batched attribution, undo and unpack of first 25 affected trips. No rendering/transfer in Node.

topology.constructionNote: Set/Array storage is engine-managed; RSS samples include it. Explicit temporaries exclude engine-managed objects.

triangle_enumeration.choice: Precomputed lower triangles: measured enumeration is faster; the 8-byte child pair per triangle costs the reported extra buffer bytes. Reverse dependencies are enumerated on demand.

baseline_note: Integer Dijkstra costs; attribution uses shipped baseline paths. A different tied Dijkstra path is recorded, never substituted.
